note: Attacker-controlled stats_array_size from the Intel custom port-stats property determines how many counters the parser will iterate over.
The loop count is driven by the untrusted counter count and advances the cursor through the payload.
The parser only checks the remaining message size before reading the counter name and value, but it does not ensure current still points to a valid counter record before dereferencing it.
When the loop advances past the available payload, this dereference reads beyond the supplied buffer and triggers the overread.
